prompt:
A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult Cuban woman — the personification of the city of Havana — one woman who IS Havana as it stands in this world. She is the subject of the picture; her costume, body, props and light carry the city's symbols and this world's marks, and the city behind her only supports her.

1. STYLE
Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the description below, not a generic pretty face.
Face proportions: Her face is small and soft: a short midface, a softly rounded jaw and a small chin, about 1.3 times as long as it is wide, with her eyes open at their natural size. Bangs, side locks and headpieces frame the face without lengthening it.

2. CHARACTER
Age: mid-twenties — a young-adult face; no facial lines.
Face — her own: a coquettish, flirtatious charm — a sidelong glance and a playful pout; bronze-brown skin; face with soft jaw angles that taper gently toward a rounded chin, not wide from the front; eyes on the larger side of natural — soft almond eyes with gently lowered outer corners, level outer eye corners; brows with a clean, angled peak; a straight nose with a slim bridge; slender lips of natural width; eyes glowing a faint ghostly blue; sharp winged eyeliner.
Skin finish: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.
Body and hair: lean and toned — a slim, firm waist with softly defined vertical abs and lightly sculpted arms and shoulders, a full bust build; shoulder-length hair with outward-flipped ends with blunt straight bangs; pale mint-green hair.
Expression: a faint knowing smile.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — CYBERPUNK
Costume: far-future techwear cut to the outfit silhouette below — smart fabric, chrome and glossy vinyl, fine straps and glowing light lines, glowing tattoo lines and cybernetic implants on her skin, holographic jewelry; sign light reflected on her face.
City motif: a fitted rider jumpsuit in two-tone candy paint of mint and cream, piped with gleaming chrome like the trim of an old car, little chrome tail-fin points at the shoulders, and a belt fastened with a round buckle shaped like a whitewall wheel.
World marks on her: glowing neon tattoos; cybernetic implants; reflective trim catching the light; sign light reflected on her face; holographic jewelry; fiber-optic glowing hair strands; chrome and glossy vinyl; magenta and cyan glow; soft holographic light shimmering across her skin and clothes; techwear traced with glowing light lines; far-future smart fabric rippling with soft light patterns.
Silhouette: a fitted rider jumpsuit with big gloves and a visor hanging at the neck — a fast, forward-leaning silhouette. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely in the city motif, the world marks and the palette. This silhouette overrides the overall shape of the costume above.
Colours: seawall sunset tangerine, Caribbean turquoise, colonial-facade pastel pink — one of these as her accent colour.
Prop: in one hand she holds a gleaming chrome hood ornament shaped like a swept-back rocket, its edges lit with a thin mint glow; her other hand is free.
Exposure (bold): her techwear opens to show skin where its silhouette allows — bare shoulders and midriff or a deep neckline with natural cleavage, and bare legs, traced with glowing tattoo lines. Intimate areas covered.

4. SCENE
World: a far-future Caribbean city two centuries on, its colonnaded old streets kept whole and glowing softly from within in coral, lemon, sky blue and mint: big rounded almond-shaped cars of the old century, repaired again and again, now glide a hand's breadth above the road as shared hover-taxis, their tail fins and chrome trim gleaming over candy two-tone paint; the long seawall has grown into a luminous tide barrier that raises curtains of light against the breaking waves; the great white dome on its ring of columns shines over terraced towers of glass hung with royal palms; across the harbour mouth the old stone fortress still holds up its lighthouse, its beam sweeping a dusk sky crossed by quiet flying vehicles.
This card: in an open-fronted street garage under a colonnade, a big rounded almond-shaped old car in two-tone candy paint floating on its lift beside her, glowing tools and the painted street bright beyond.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Light: a soft key light with a strong rim light tracing her hair, shoulders and armour; bright, crisp specular highlights on metal and jewellery, and a clean, warm-neutral sheen on her skin.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text, lettering or numbers anywhere in the picture; no logo or watermark.
Avoid: second character, living creature, logo, watermark, speech bubble, frame border, text, lettering, numbers anywhere in the picture, a blue or bruise-like tint on the skin around the eyes, glossy or shiny highlights on the face, sweaty, oily or plastic-looking skin.
